name: OAIC Notifiable Data Breaches statistics
regulator: Office of the Australian Information Commissioner
unit_of_observation: One published aggregate metric cell for a reporting period and source-defined dimension
source_threshold: Notifications concern eligible data breaches under Part IIIC of the Privacy Act 1988; the workbook contains aggregate statistics, not a register of named notifications.
source_population: Notifications received under the NDB scheme; affected-person figures use the source-labelled Australian or worldwide population.
public_window: Historical reporting-period workbook published through Data.gov.au and subject to revision.
attribution: Office of the Australian Information Commissioner
correction_process: Check the current Data.gov.au resource and OAIC dashboard notes before publishing a correction.
limitations: The figures are based on information self-reported by notifying entities.
Aggregate records do not identify reporting entities.
Notification counts are not automatically unique real-world incidents.
